title.narrative: Leveraging Global Fund’s RSSH investments in DRC to contribute to the attainment of universal health coverage and other health-related targets of the Sustainable Development Goals - Congo (Democratic Republic) (01-Jan-2024-31-Dec-2026)

description.narrative: Congo (Democratic Republic), RSSH, Ministry of Public Health, Hygiene and Social Security (MOH DRC)This program has the following goals: Contribuer au bien-être de la population congolaise d’ici 2026 dans le cadre de la couverture sanitaire universelle et des autres cibles des objectifs de développement durable (ODD) / Contribute to the well-being of the Congolese population by 2026 as part of universal health coverage and other targets of the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).. The objectives of this program are: Axe stratégique 1 : Amélioration des prestations des services de santé et continuité des soins / Strategic focus 1: Improving health service delivery and continuity of care.. Axe stratégique 2 : Appui aux piliers du système de santé pour améliorer la disponibilité et l’accessibilité de soins de qualité / Strategic focus 2: Support for the pillars of the health system to improve the availability and accessibility of quality care.. Axe stratégique 3 : Appui à la gouvernance, au leadership et au pilotage du système de santé / Strategic focus 3: Support for governance, leadership and management of the health system.

title.narrative: Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for COD-S-MOHP03
RSSH/PP HRH 5-other 1 Percentage of supervisors of the central office of the health zone (BCZ) implementing formative supervision that includes key characteristics
Completeness of reporting: Percentage of expected monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are actually received
LMIS Reporting Rate - Percentage of all health facilities that are required to report that submit an LMIS report to central authority
Percentage of community health workers providing high quality HIV, TB and malaria services
Percentage of districts that produce at least semi-annual analytical reports

HPM-1-Other 1: Completeness rate of reporting in the SIGL: percentage of health zones' in the 5 UTGL provinces that are required to report and that submit complete data in the SIGL monthly report to the provincial authority.
Timeliness of reporting: Percentage of submitted monthly reports (for the reporting period) that are received on time per the national guidelines
Percentage of health service delivery sites with a community-led monitoring mechanism in place
Outcome indicators targets and results for COD-S-MOHP03
On-shelf availability: Percentage of facilities with tracer health products for the three diseases - HIV, TB, malaria (as applicable) available on the day of the visit or day of reporting
Impact indicators targets and results for COD-S-MOHP03
HIV I-other 1: Number of AIDS-related deaths per 100,000 inhabitants
Malaria I-other 1: Registered malaria cases (presumed and confirmed)
TB I-other1: Incidence rate of tuberculosis per 100,000 inhabitants
HIV I-other 2: Estimated percentage of children newly infected with HIV through mother-to-child transmission among HIV-positive women who gave birth in the last 12 months
Malaria I- other 2 Malaria deaths: rate per 100,000 people per year
TB/HIV I- other 1: TB/HIV mortality rate (per 100,000 inhabitants)
